book.name: Yon
book.title: Yon Dowan Weng Olo Yone Dolanebuotabe.

content: Yesuse imin hanasebe.

Yesuse dobbunib sonoma bomanoa imin bliba bi kwinoa sibnoma Sande boman tebua klao mo glik geim blim sma mili kikibua Maliao Magdala bib ulako monoa Yesuse gloutemo temoa tom kwame amite dobdou walibbue daleb taniba ken tam dabaibbio

kesoa atemnoa hebmamsab imin tenoa Saimon Fita esa eka Yesuse gotne binebio naka nesa baabenoa I nib Sume kaanea tom temo dofaibbuo sanggwan debeb unibbiobe. Ne mo tekein kebibabe, debeb moniba afet yefamak dofaibbiobo ge baabesoa Fitae ni dabsak Gloutem unomo genoba
dab makob blublu bebob otane ne Fitae gaisania neta sin monia gloutem ye uni
otane biin wato onamino deibonia besa delab mania biin wato watemnia eka youm ota watem nanabia
Saimon Fitae ne abuk tle eta watnea biin wat unanea youmo watemnea
eka youm make Yesuse gabame gebaibbu esa atem nasebe. Youm ele youm mako i sinwalo makobo mo dlaim blimobe. E halbu geniba afet ye dofaibbua atem nasea
eka sin tlibio nesak watnia inamin namin olo watem tekein kenia Yesuse bain hana unebiobo ge naibiobe.
Ni inanobbuo Gode buk temo baanoa Gode Dofakamin Nakae kaanea Imin hananamabebo genobuo ni kibinabob otane o mitmakamo klao mo tekein keim blim binabob biotabe.
Yesuse tetemea Maliao Magdala bib ulako atemsobe.
Yesuse okok aleyemin naka ni inanoba imin nini am unob
otane Malia ole imin tenoa gloutem ye bianoa mebianoa gabam delab manoa biin wato temoa
abiseli youm namao dlusaniba make Yesuse gabam ofa bine dae tounea eka mak ele skil ola bine dae touna bliba yatemnabua
i baaboniba Obo fatnanebta mebebe? ge baabosiba o baabenoa I ne Sume debeb moniba afet dofaibbu ese makobo, ne mo tekein kebibabo ge baabe nabianoa
deskinoa temoa Yesuse melen kabo ele mabia atemo otane o mo tekein kenota Yesus etabo geim blimobe.
E baabonea Obo wane dafa mebianebta hembebe? ge baabone otane o funanoa Damib kimanin naka etabo genoa baabanoa Kobo debeb moneba afet dofaneb biamo baatnenale! Ne monia debeb unamabibo gesoa
Yesuse baabonea Maliao gesea o e wengo wentenoa dlou unanoa deskinanoa Hiblu wengo baanoa Labonai ge baabasobe. Weng olo mitmakamo aleyemin naka kebtabo genaminobe.

Yesuse baabonea Ne Ay esuo mo unim blim bli kesoa obo ne mo nafunemebe! Deitneneba moneba ne nekwali baabeneba Yesuse baanea Ne monia Aye God esu unamabibe. E ibsa ib Ay Godobo genebo ge baabenale ge baabonea
Maliao Magdala bib ulako monoa e okok aleyemin naka ni baabenoa Ne Sume atemibo ge baabenoa eka e wengo baabone osa baabenasobe.
Yesuse tetemea e okok aleyemin naka ni atemsobobe.

Sande kwinoa Yesuse okok aleyemin naka ni dli te minoba funanoba Yudai komokwali nisa yenanomabiobo ge funanoba tosiananob kesoa amisalo neketowanoba amda tam dounoba bioba Yesuse tenea ni isak daak manea baabenea Ibo mo tosianimibe! Bobol ayam blibte ge baabenea
e kweilo silo bikibaibbu osa eka anate geilam wate bikiniba tulabaibbu osa alebesea ni watem tekein kenoba Nib Sume bain hananebo genoba kla seinsoba
Yesuse imin baabenea Ibo mo tosianimibe! Bobol ayam blibte! Ne Aye nemanea tenia e okoko okok kebi inania ibsa dlaia moniba e okoko okok kemine ge baabenea
e hobe fugebenea baabenea Ne Gode Hobe dobyibo, ibo dibine!

Nakaia unangai hengmino hengabibo deibueiba ibo baabeniba Ni ib hengmino o bobolo imino mo funomabbiobabo ge baabeib mole Gode esa inanea i hengmino bobolo imino mo funamabebabe. E omtlabenamabebe. Eka nakaia unangai hengmino hengabibo mo deibueim blim keiba ibo baabeniba Ni ib hengmino bobolo funino mo dokobenomobabo ge baabeib mole God esa hengmin olo mo omtlabenemebabe. E amitie funamabebo ge baabenea deibe onsebe.
Yesuse tetemea Tomase atemsebe.
Yesuse imin hana tetemea e okok aleyemin naka ni atemsob olo dimo e okok aleyemin naka make Tomase, e niniin afeto Didimase blimobe. Mak nita bioba Yesuse tetemea atemobbua

bianoba Tomase baabanoba Ni Sume atemobbiobo gesoba Tomase baabenea Ne e kweilono sil alango watemnia ne kweile melebonia eka anat alange atemnia ne kweile minia binai wat onsea hatem nanim blim kenimio ne mo bainobo genimibabo ge baabenebua

bianoba Sande elekiem kenoba Yesuse okok aleyemin naka ni alukum am tam minoba Tomas etem nanoba amisalo neketowanoba amda tam dounoba bioba Yesuse tenea ni isak daak manea baabenea Ibo mo tosianimibe! Bobol ayam blibte ge baabenea
e Tomase baabanea Kobo ne kweilo wateneba sil alango meleboneba eka keb kweile tebeb wat teneba ne anat alange hatem naneba kobo bobol tem hekhek funino deiboneba bainobo genale ge baabasea
Tomase baabanea Kobo God, ne Sumobo gesea
Yesuse baabanea Kobo natemnebta bainobo gabeb otane nakaia unangai ne mo natemin blim bianiba bainobo gabib ile Gode seinin sumo omyamabebo ge baabasebe.
Yon ne weng olo mitmakamo inaminobe.
Yesuse okok sumo mak osa ye klabea e okok aleyemin naka ni watemobbu otane ne o weng sango alukumo mo dolanamabibabe.

Ina otane weng ele dolai olole ne funania Nakaia unangai tekein keniba Yesuse Gode Dofakamin Naka eka e Gode miin nabo geniba e bainobo geniba afen smike doboniba amit nine genita weng olo dolanamabibe.
